name: Thoth's Riddle
description:
About This Game

Can You Escape the Pyramid of Thoth?

You have been tasked with exploring the mysterious Pyramid of Thoth, an ancient structure filled with forgotten mechanisms, hidden chambers, and secrets lost to time.

But your expedition takes an unexpected turn.

You awoke into a chamber deep within the Pyramid. The only path forward is through the Pyramid itself.

Seven Puzzles. Seven Elements. One Escape.

Hidden throughout the Pyramid are 7 uniquely themed puzzles, each designed around a different element.

Darkness  Navigate through the dark using a long forgotten technique.
Fire The floor is lava! But once you jump across, a puzzle filled with wires awaits you.
Water  Use water streams and your timing skills to get an object at its right place.
Earth  Play with combinations of mysterious symbols to find your way.
Light  Solve a unique puzzle after avoiding a path filled with lasers.
Air Obtain the right pressure by connecting pipes to play the harmonic tune.
The Final Puzzle  Decipher the last riddle using your translation skills to find your way out!

Each puzzle introduces its own mechanics and challenges. No two puzzles are quite the same.

Every chamber of the Pyramid has its own unique soundtrack, carefully matched to its theme.

Think. Explore. Experiment.

The Pyramid will not simply hand you the answers.

Look closely at your surroundings. Interact with objects. Experiment with the mechanisms you find. Some solutions may seem obvious, while others will require you to connect clues from different parts of the chamber.

The deeper you go into the Pyramid, the more you may question why the Pyramid was built in the first place.

The Pyramid Awaits

Seven chambers.

Seven challenges.

Seven elements.

And one way out.

Will you uncover the secrets of Thoth and escape the Pyramid?

Or will you become another forgotten secret buried within its walls?

Can you solve all 7 puzzles?

Enter the Pyramid of Thoth and find out.
short_desc: Can you escape the Pyramid of Thoth? You have been tasked to explore the Pyramid and uncover its secrets. But you have fallen into the chamber and now must escape this mysterious Pyramid by solving 7 uniquely themed puzzles.
